title: Define interaction protocol for inline editing and toggle-group inputs
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: Several product surfaces exhibit inconsistent behavior for inline editable text fields, compound toggle groups, and select-like token inputs. Differences include focus stroke weight, error treatment (inline message vs field-level red ring), prefix/suffix (clear/reveal) alignment with density tokens, and keyboard affordances for editing tokenized values. These inconsistencies cause support noise, accessibility failures in keyboard/AT flows, and make QA surface-level regressions when density or theming tokens change.

Goal: Define a single interaction protocol and visual language for three related component families: inline-edit text fields, grouped toggles (multi-toggle / segmented controls used as boolean groups), and tokenized/select inputs with editable chips. Deliver a spec that covers visual tokens (focus/hover/disabled/error), motion/transition guidance for state changes, keyboard behavior, and a migration plan for the component library with acceptance tests and rollout strategy.

Scope: tokens, component API adjustments, design token mapping for compact vs default density, accessibility keyboard & screen reader patterns, example implementation notes for React + CSS-in-JS and suggested test matrix. Not in scope: full engineering implementation of server-side autosave or CRDT merging for concurrent inline edits (handled separately).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Authoritative spec published (Figma + Confluence) that defines: focus/hover/error/disabled visual tokens, keyboard flows (enter/esc/tab/arrow interactions) for inline edit and tokenized inputs, ARIA attributes for combined components.
2) Library change set with clear migration notes: prop changes documented, deprecation timeline, and code examples for toggles and inline fields.
3) Unit + e2e test checklist and sample Cypress tests covering keyboard navigation, error announcements, and token deletion.
4) Design review approval from PM & Accessibility owner and one engineering signoff.
5) Small-scope rollout to two product surfaces behind feature flag with metrics tracked (keyboard failures, field-error regressions).
comments: 2026-02-19 - Priya K: Marking as P1 because Support flagged several regressions after density token change. We'll need an estimate from Eng on lift for token mapping.
2026-02-26 - Liam O'Neill (Eng): Early review — we prefer to avoid new props on ToggleGroup; propose a mapping layer that adapts existing API for density. Will follow up with prototype PR.

2026-03-02 - Accessibility (Marta Ruiz): Concern: current inline-edit loses announcement on save when using role=application. Suggest using live region for success/error. Will add ARIA recommendations to the spec.

2026-03-05 - Priya K: Attached a compact-design page showing conflict between prefix-affix spacing and compact tokens. Decision: preserve token spacing and adjust affordance size rather than reduce spacing in compact mode.

2026-03-10 - Eng review (Liam): Prototype PR created with token mapping and keyboard helpers. Found edge case: chip-edit mode should trap arrow keys when editing to avoid unintentionally moving focus; added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-12 - Design signoff (Avery): Resolving motion timings to 80ms for state crossfade to match other DS transitions. Preparing Confluence doc for rollout notes.
